title: What changed in Iboga and Ibogaine: May 2026 field brief
summary: Current field movement is concentrated in state policy, FDA-linked research language, public funding, podcast and media attention, and safety/culture scrutiny. IbogaBase treats this as a source map, not as evidence of treatment availability or clinical proof.

items.headline: FDA allowed an early-phase noribogaine study to proceed in the U.S.
items.whatChanged: FDA announced that DemeRx NB may begin a closely monitored phase I noribogaine hydrochloride study for alcohol use disorder.
items.whatItDoesNotMean: This is not drug approval, not a finding of safety or effectiveness, and not patient access guidance.

items.headline: Oklahoma HB 3834 was approved by the governor.
items.whatChanged: Oklahoma's bill page shows HB 3834, the Oklahoma Breakthrough Therapy Act for ibogaine clinical trials, approved by the governor on May 12, 2026.
items.whatItDoesNotMean: It does not make ibogaine FDA-approved and does not erase federal Schedule I constraints.

items.headline: Texas remains the central public-funding case study.
items.whatChanged: Texas SB 2308 created a pathway for a selected consortium to conduct ibogaine drug development clinical trials and includes a subchapter that applies only if FDA approves ibogaine for a medical condition.
items.whatItDoesNotMean: Texas law is not proof of efficacy and does not mean treatment is available outside federal law and research controls.

items.headline: Tennessee HOPE Act materials describe proposed ibogaine drug-development trials.
items.whatChanged: The Tennessee fiscal note for HB 2075 / SB 2149 describes the Helping Open Pathways to Effective Treatment Act and proposed cohort-based ibogaine drug-development trials.
items.whatItDoesNotMean: The fiscal note is not clinical evidence and explicitly frames key activity around FDA approval and state/federal constraints.
items.source: Tennessee General Assembly Fiscal Review Committee

items.headline: Podcast and interview discovery is now a standing intake lane.
items.whatChanged: The source catalog contains a growing podcast/interview directory and a dedicated Listening Library Curator role.
items.whatItDoesNotMean: Interview statements are not treated as facts until converted into claim records and traced to supporting sources.
